messages:
elaine: starting a guarded v2 push to edge-cluster-7. keep header byte preservation, do NOT apply case normalization in this slice. quiet window 40m.
tom: copy. ramp plan?
elaine: 4% -> 15% -> 40% with 8m waits and probe checks. rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% or client-schema-errors > 0.4% or any pinned-tenant > 1.5%.
rachel: adding note: older embed clients sometimes read raw header bytes, so preserve bytes to avoid deserializers tripping. also add mobile-pin threshold.
ejared: deploy-bot, kick off first canary and run probe against fallback too.
deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] initiated by jared at 7088881234. target: edge-cluster-7, initial traffic 4%.
tom: probe commands: curl -H 'Client-Version: v2' https://edge7.api.redwood/v2/health && curl https://edge7.api.redwood/v1/health to validate fallback.
rachel: initial canary probes green after 60s. no 5xx.
tom: small p95 bump on short-tail generation but within SLO. no client-schema-errors yet.
ejared: move to 15% when ready.
deploy-bot: [traffic update] moved to 15% at 7088881300. probes: ok.
elaine: keep debug logs for 90m. posting runbook link in thread. DO NOT merge PRs that change header matching behavior in the next hour.
tom: spotted a very small blip from a legacy tenant, 0.09% schema-errors, not pinned. tracking.
rachel: set micro-alert at 0.25% so we notice drift early.
ejared: operator handback planned at 7088881360 if stable.
deploy-bot: [operator-handback] scheduled at 7088881360. rollforward note: "edge-cluster-7 v2 guarded push; header bytes preserved; monitor pinned tenants"
elaine: thanks team. if any pinned tenant crosses 1.5% we roll back immediately to 4% and open a hotpatch channel.
tom: acknowledged, staying on watch.
rachel: will follow up with a short release-notes blurb about header handling and SDK recommendations.
ejared: handing back to ops in 10m. :white_check_mark:
